name: newspaper
description: An aged newspaper clipping slides in on the board: masthead rule with a date, a big serif headline, an optional subhead, an optional halftone photo and columns of grey text lines. Like the "LA JOCONDE A DISPARU" front page in the reference reel. `language` sets the language of the headline (hyphenation and quotes), so a French or Indonesian headline breaks correctly.
useWhen: the speaker quotes a headline, a news report or a front page
an event is introduced as news (a theft, an election, a launch, a disaster)
a date and a headline together anchor a story
